meta.title: Carolo Canis Ltd.
meta.description: Carolo Canis Ltd. is a small, tightly focused company working in cynology: dog training, equipment and food, and cynology advice.

hero.title: Carolo Canis
hero.lede: Carolo Canis Ltd. is a small, tightly focused company working in cynology in the areas of dog training, trade in dog equipment and food, and cynology advice arising from the owner’s authority as a court expert in cynology and a working-dog judge.

about.title: About
about.lead: Many enter the world of cynology unprepared, curious and sincere — yet, as in so much else, problems sometimes catch them on the first steps, and with time some become too large.
about.p1: A tradition of some twenty years gives us the freedom to offer you, as a company, help so that everything becomes easier, faster and better.
about.p2: Through these pages you can get to know us and our partners, get answers to some of your questions, resolve basic problems with your own dog, and even enjoy cynology if it becomes more than a pastime.

consult.title: Talk and assessment
consult.body: First contact, understanding the needs of dog and owner, and agreeing on training goals.

individual.title: Individual approach
individual.body: No group classes — every dog and owner get their own plan. No two dogs are the same, nor are their owners’ demands.

session.title: Open weekly slot
session.body: One course per week within an agreed window. Come when it suits you — order of arrival is respected.

exam.title: Training exam
exam.body: At the end of the course we recommend taking one — a confirmation of success for you and those around you, at multiple levels.

payment.title: Flexible payment
payment.body: In instalments, phased with the training. Nothing upfront, missed sessions are not charged.
